proof_summary: At the seventh step, the required divisor is \(a(5)=171\), which is divisible by \(19\), while \(a(6)=(2^{171}+1)/9\equiv3\pmod{18}\) (since \(2^{171}+1\equiv27\pmod{162}\)). Fermat’s theorem then gives \(2^{a(6)}+1\equiv2^3+1=9\not\equiv0\pmod{19}\), so it cannot be divisible by \(171\).
